case_title: JAGGA SINGH AND ANR. v. STATE OF PUNJAB
neutral_facts: The prosecution case is that three accused approached the house of Raja Singh. One of them fired at Baggar Singh, hitting him on the right thigh, causing him to fall. The accused then took Hoshiar Singh, another individual, away towards a village. Approximately 20 minutes later, the sound of three or four gunshots was heard. The next morning, the dead body of Hoshiar Singh was found. The post mortem report indicated that the deceased had only lacerated wounds, with no gunshot wounds present. The trial court convicted the accused under Section 307 IPC, while the High Court convicted them under Section 302 IPC. However, the Supreme Court found that the prosecution's case regarding the charge under Section 302 IPC was uncertain due to the absence of gunshot wounds on the deceased's body, leading to the acquittal of the accused on that charge.
